component.name: state-store
component.title: State Store
component.description: Store, get and delete key-value entries in a pluggable KeyValueRepository, such as an in-memory store or a shared cache.
component.label: cache

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

namespaced.description: The default of the namespaced option of the endpoints: whether to prefix the keys with the store name in a backend set on the endpoint or found in the registry, so that stores sharing one repository do not see each other's keys.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

backendFactory.label: advanced
backendFactory.description: Creates a dedicated backend for each store name, for the endpoints that set no backend. It takes precedence over the KeyValueRepository found in the registry, which is used when the factory returns null. The component starts and stops the backends it creates, and does not prefix their keys.

CamelStateStoreOperation.label: producer
CamelStateStoreOperation.description: The operation to perform, which overrides the operation option. A String value is matched to the operation name ignoring case.

CamelStateStoreKey.label: producer
CamelStateStoreKey.description: The key of the entry. Required by put, putIfAbsent, get, delete and contains; keys, size and clear do not use it.

CamelStateStoreTtl.label: producer
CamelStateStoreTtl.description: The time to live in milliseconds of the entry that put or putIfAbsent stores, which overrides the ttl option. 0 or a negative value means that the entry does not expire.

producerIn.description: The value to store for put and putIfAbsent, as it is, except a stream: an InputStream or the stream cache of Camel is read into memory and stored as its bytes, and a Reader as its text, a String. The other operations do not use the body

producerOut.description: By the operation, which the CamelStateStoreOperation header can set: the stored value for get, the previous value for put, the value already there for putIfAbsent and the removed value for delete, each no body when there is none; a Boolean for contains, the Set of the keys for keys, the count for size and no body for clear. The value is the object the backend gives back: the in-memory one the object stored, another may give a copy; a stream was stored as a byte array, and a Reader as a String

storeName.description: The name of the store. The endpoints with the same store name in one CamelContext share one backend, and the first of them that starts decides which backend it is and whether its keys are namespaced.

namespaced.description: Whether to prefix the keys with the store name in a backend set with the backend option or found in the registry, so that stores sharing one repository do not see each other's keys. When false, keys, size and clear act on all the entries of the repository. An in-memory store and a backend from the backendFactory of the component are never prefixed.

operation.description: The operation to perform when the message has no CamelStateStoreOperation header. Without either, the producer fails. All operations except keys, size and clear need the key in the CamelStateStoreKey header.

ttl.description: The time to live in milliseconds of the entries that put and putIfAbsent store. 0 or a negative value means that the entries do not expire. The CamelStateStoreTtl header overrides it per message.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer,advanced
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

backend.label: advanced
backend.description: The KeyValueRepository that holds the entries. If not set, the backendFactory of the component creates one for the store name; without a factory, or when it returns null, the single KeyValueRepository in the registry is used, and with none or several of them, a new in-memory store.
